messages:
Samira (Finance): Quick heads-up — TelosCloud APAC just uploaded their April invoice (received today). Billing period 2025-04-01 to 2025-04-30, invoice date 2025-05-05, amount USD 48,750. We closed April yesterday. Do we (a) accrue the vendor cost into April COGS, or (b) record in May? Need revrec/COGS guidance + an approved JE before EOD close tomorrow. Invoice link: https://gcs.redwood/example/telos-apac-0425.pdf :paperclip:

Aiko (Billing): Confirmed — invoice PDF and vendor remittance on the attachment. PO 98765. Vendor billing lag is their usual APAC cadence, they typically bill ~1 week after month. No customer-facing pass-through here; this is a vendor cost for Dedicated infra we operate.

Jules (Accounting): If the service was consumed in April (billing period indicates that), GAAP requires we match expense to period of consumption. So we should accrue COGS for April and book AP for the vendor. Post the accrual JE, then clear when invoice hits AP.

Liam (Revenue): +1 to accrual. On revenue side, if we already recognized customer revenue tied to this capacity in April, no change. This is purely a cost/timing issue unless there's a contractual revenue adjustment.

Samira (Finance): OK makes sense. Proposed accrual JE (to be posted to April close):
```
Debit: COGS - Third-party infra 48,750.00
Credit: Accrued Liabilities / Accounts Payable 48,750.00
Narrative: Accrual for TelosCloud APAC invoice covering 2025-04-01 to 2025-04-30. Invoice received 2025-05-05; expense recognized in April to match consumption.
```

Jules (Accounting): JE looks good. Please include vendor invoice number and upload to Concur/DocStore with accounting reference (GL codes: 6100, AP vendor: TEL-APAC). Also tag the entry with the close package ID: APR25_CLOSE_RevRec.

Marcus (Finance Manager): Approved. Post accrual with reversed clearing when actual AP posts. Samira, please route to Treasury for payment scheduling notes if they ask about timing. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: invoice-upload event detected — teloscloud_apac/invoices/2025-05-05/TEL-APAC-4552.pdf uploaded by aiko@redwood.com at 2025-05-06T10:22Z.

Aiko (Billing): FYI vendor replied — they confirmed invoice date and asked for net30 payment schedule. Will keep AP looped.

Samira (Finance): I'll post the accrual JE now to the close binder and cc Jules for review. Will update this thread when done and attach the JE number. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
